value.rationale: A natural two-person boundary of the new stochastic nonlinear public-goods model has an exact all-parameter no-cycle/neutral-cycle transition at r=2; this differs qualitatively from the open attracting-cycle wedge exhibited for larger groups. The nontrivial invariant supplies every orbit and its area form, while the universal cooperator/environment means and exact zero temporal covariance are directly interpretable long-run observables despite persistent oscillations. These are a structural phase boundary and an experimentally relevant invariant prediction, rather than a routine small parameter improvement.
